title: SB38 (2019 Regular): provide for the carrying of a concealed pistol without a permit.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2019-01-06; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/51398.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 51398, BillId 9405))
provenance.note: As filed. Sections 1-4 repeal SDCL 22-14-9 (concealed carry without permit offence), 22-14-9.1 (must carry permit), 22-14-10 (unloaded pistol transport exception) and 22-14-11 (home/business exception); those repeals are struck text and are not quoted. Section 6 keeps the 18+ age and background check conditions for a temporary permit; Section 7 (SDCL 23-7-7.4) and Section 8 (22-14-9.2) edit nonresident and reciprocity wording; Section 9 (23-7-8.1) removes the 'carry anywhere except bars' sentence. No passage vote recorded.

operative_text:
Section 5 (SDCL 23-7-7): The issuance of a permit to carry a concealed pistol pursuant to this chapter or the recognition of nonresident permits to carry a concealed pistol under § 23-7-7.4 do not impose a general prohibition on the carry of a pistol without a permit.
Section 10 (SDCL 23-7-8.13): Upon the expiration of a permit to carry a concealed pistol that was issued pursuant to this chapter, the permit holder has a sixty-day grace period to renew the permit. During the grace period, the permit holder may continue to carry a concealed pistol
Section 11 (SDCL 23-7-9): Any pistol that is delivered, shall be securely wrapped and shall be unloaded. A violation of this section is a Class 1 misdemeanor.
Section 12 (new section in SDCL ch. 23-7): No person may carry a concealed pistol in any licensed on-sale malt beverage or alcoholic beverage establishment that derives over one-half of its total income from the sale of malt or alcoholic beverages.
